procedure: Click on the field where you want to enter or modify text (e.g., 'Variable name' or 'Value').
Select all existing content in the active field by pressing Ctrl+A (or Cmd+A on Mac).

Type the desired new value into the selected field to overwrite the current content completely. Ensure it matches your intended variable or value format (e.g., alphanumeric, no special characters unless allowed).

Click outside the field or on another control to confirm entry and lose focus from the input box — this often triggers validation or auto-save behavior depending on context (e.g., form submission or editor save).
Repeat steps 1–4 for any additional fields if needed (e.g., entering a second variable/value pair).
